Classical Themes (rough)

The original 9,824 themes (midi2abc from the EDM MIDI), unreliable, kept for reference. Not linked from the menus.

Reference only: partly unreliable. The original set of 9,824 themes. The 2,067 that the Musical Theme Dataset has are its corrected versions (tagged "corrected (MTD)", played at their recording's tempo); they are also on Classical Themes. The rest are midi2abc conversions of the Electronic Dictionary of Musical Themes MIDI, with beams and repeated accidentals tidied but the notes as they were: many are barred from the first note instead of the pickup, have lost or broken triplets, or sit an octave off. Themes that sit very high have been moved down an octave by rule (tagged "octave lowered (guessed)"; the rule was right 98.7% of the time on the themes MTD also has), which catches a bit under half of the octave errors. Those play at 96 unless you type a tempo in.
